why_ai: The product is physical space people keep renting, but pricing, rentals, access and collections run on software and remote agents, leaving maintenance, audits and lien cleanouts on site.
why_clarity: Occupancy, rent per foot and move-outs are measured daily, and the same rentals, increases and lien steps repeat across thousands of units.
why_digital: Units are physical and local, but most customers find, rent and pay online, and pricing and administration happen on screens.

why_ai: Sizing increases is screen work on ledger data that pricing models already do at the REITs, though consumer-protection rules keep a human accountable for the policy.
why_clarity: Net rent after move-outs is measurable and increases recur monthly by the thousand, but the counterfactual and the 90-day outcome lag make feedback slow.
why_digital: Tenant ledgers in, recommendations and notices out, all digital, bought from software vendors remotely.

why_ai: Enrolment and pricing automate readily, but licensed limited-lines selling and state filings keep accountable people in the loop.
why_clarity: Attachment, premiums and loss ratios are exact numbers on a codified product, with claims outcomes arriving over months.
why_digital: Enrolment, billing and claims are digital, while programmes are sold through relationships with operators.

why_ai: Notices and scheduling automate, but cutting locks, handling belongings and answering for a wrongful sale stay with accountable people on site.
why_clarity: Each state's statute codifies the steps and deadlines, and files repeat by the thousand, though disputes surface late.
why_digital: Notices and listings are digital, but the work ends at a physical unit, lock and cleanout.

why_ai: Reminders, payment links and outreach ranking are routine work that agents and dialler software absorb readily.
why_clarity: Recovered rent per delinquent unit is exact, the contact cycle repeats daily, and payment or silence shows within days.
why_digital: Ledger data in, texts, calls and payments out, run remotely.

why_ai: Cutting the lock, photographing and clearing the unit is physical, while listing and bidding are already online.
why_clarity: Hammer price against balance owed is exact and known at the sale, though every unit's contents differ.
why_digital: The sale runs on online marketplaces, but the input is a physical unit photographed on site.

why_ai: Walking doors and checking locks is hands-on site work, though smart locks and sensors shrink how many doors need a visit.
why_clarity: Each door matches the ledger or it does not, and the same check repeats across hundreds of doors every week.
why_digital: The input is physical doors and locks, recorded on paper or phones, with tools bought from remote vendors.

why_ai: Owners run a physical property with a manager on site, and pricing and administration are what software can take over.
why_clarity: Rental income is measurable, but each owner sets rates and increases their own way.
why_digital: Physical units and local customers, with rentals and payments moving online at a slower pace than at the REITs.

why_ai: Vehicles must be parked, fitted into spaces and moved on site, while billing and access automate.
why_clarity: Revenue per acre and occupancy are measurable, but space fitting and seasonal pricing are done by feel.
why_digital: The input and delivery are physical vehicles and land, sold to local owners of RVs and boats.

why_ai: Daily web-rate setting on public competitor data is already automated at the REITs and is the most model-ready decision in the business.
why_clarity: Rates change daily against measurable move-ins within days, by a codifiable rule set.
why_digital: Rate pages and ledgers in, web rates out, all digital and bought as software.

why_ai: Removing on-site staff is the automation itself; what remains is maintenance, incidents and remote agents that AI is absorbing.
why_clarity: Occupancy against staffed comparables is measurable, and rentals and access events repeat daily with quick feedback.
why_digital: Rentals, access and support run digitally and remotely, around a physical site and its gates and locks.

why_ai: Programme pricing and claims analysis are screen work, but licensed underwriting and filings carry personal and corporate accountability.
why_clarity: Premiums, claims and loss ratios are exact and repeat across thousands of policies, with losses known over months.
why_digital: Policy, claims and pricing data in, cover and filings out, sold to operators nationally.

why_ai: Software platforms' analytics and product work is fully on screens and exposed to AI-native competitors.
why_clarity: Product and analytics deliverables are defined per feature, with usage and revenue feedback over weeks.
why_digital: Entirely digital work sold and delivered remotely.

why_ai: Managers run owners' stores through site staff and owner relationships, with pricing and reporting moving to software.
why_clarity: Owner statements and net operating income are measured monthly, but each owner's goals and contracts differ.
why_digital: Owner reporting is digital, but the service is running physical stores won through owner relationships.

why_ai: Rate and increase recommendations are model output on client data, the kind of work AI-native tools replace first.
why_clarity: Revenue lift is measurable per client, though attribution and move-out effects take months.
why_digital: Data in, recommendations out, sold as software to operators anywhere.

why_ai: Central pricing and increase teams work on screens, and their models already do most of the sizing; judgment remains on policy and regulation.
why_clarity: Rent per foot and move-outs are measured daily across millions of tenancies, with increase outcomes known over months.
why_digital: Internal digital work on ledger data, delivered as rates and notices.

why_ai: Locks, gates and kiosks must be installed and serviced on site, while the software layer is digital.
why_clarity: Doors open or not and events are logged exactly, across repeated installs.
why_digital: Hardware and installation are physical, while the access software and buying are increasingly remote.

why_ai: Search, matching and pricing on a marketplace are on-screen work exposed to AI and to Google's own tools.
why_clarity: Bookings, conversions and take rate are measured continuously on near-identical transactions.
why_digital: Fully online marketplaces.

why_ai: Listing, bidding and payment run online; the physical cleanout stays with buyers and stores.
why_clarity: Each sale closes at a price on a fixed date, repeated thousands of times.
why_digital: Online listings of physically stored lots, bought by bidders nationally.

why_ai: Scripted rentals, payments and gate resets are exactly what voice and chat agents now complete end to end.
why_clarity: Calls resolve or not, convert or not, and repeat by the thousand daily.
why_digital: Entirely remote phone and digital service.

why_ai: Appraisals carry signed professional liability and site visits, though desk feasibility work is exposed to data tools.
why_clarity: Each study is one-off and outcomes (lease-up, sale price) arrive years later.
why_digital: Studies are written on screens from data and site visits, bought by lenders and developers.

why_ai: Brokerage rests on owner relationships and negotiation on unique deals; the research is marketing around them.
why_clarity: Each deal is unique and brokers work differently, with outcomes known only at closing.
why_digital: Research is digital, but deals are won through relationships and local knowledge.

why_ai: Investing and acquiring rely on capital relationships and judgment on unique deals.
why_clarity: Returns are measurable but known years later, and each acquisition differs.
why_digital: Underwriting is digital, but the assets are physical stores bought through relationships.

why_ai: Lobbying and member representation depend on trust and relationships, while research is commissioned.
why_clarity: Advocacy and research outcomes are diffuse and slow to judge.
why_digital: Mostly digital publications and member services, with in-person conferences and lobbying.

why_ai: Enforcement and lawmaking are reserved to accountable public officials.
why_clarity: Rules are codified, but enforcement cases differ and their effects show slowly.
why_digital: Complaints and rules are handled digitally, but the authority is local and fixed.
